abort.discovery_not_supported: An Enet Smart Home server was discovered, but setting it up from discovery is not supported yet. Please add the integration manually.

user.title: Connect to the Enet Smart Home server
user.description: Enter the address and the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the Enet Smart Home server
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the login of your Enet Smart Home server.

data_description.url: Address of the Enet Smart Home server, for example http://192.168.1.10. Use https:// if the server is set up for it.
data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate again
reauth_confirm.description: The Enet Smart Home server at {url} rejected the login. Enter the username and password again.

data_description.username: User name used to log in to the Enet Smart Home server.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Stores the current state of every light, switch and cover of the scene in the scene on the Enet server.

set_scene_level.name: Set scene level
set_scene_level.description: Changes the level of one member of the scene on the Enet server.

member.name: Member
member.description: Light, switch or cover of the scene to change.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of a dimmer in the scene, 0 is off.

state.name: State
state.description: On or off, for switches and lights.

position.name: Position
position.description: Position of a cover in the scene, 100 is open.

tilt_position.name: Tilt position
tilt_position.description: Tilt position of a blind in the scene, 100 is open.

data_description.scenes: Which scenes of the Enet server are added to Home Assistant. Scenes that are no longer added are removed.

options.libenet: Only scenes with "libenet" in the name
options.all: All scenes made in the Enet app
options.all_with_location: All scenes, and the lights on/off scenes the server creates for each room
